policy.memory: input retained; RSS snapshots + 250ms OS polls, not exact peak or index size
policy.scanRole: correctness only; verify elapsed is not query latency
policy.read: complete navigation + one page; method timer overhead included; hashing/serialization excluded
policy.first: first for this query in a fresh process, not guaranteed cold runtime or OS cache
policy.order: paired sizes per seed; reverse sizes for middle seed; all 10 queries in original order per measured job
policy.limits: step 30s; process 120s; observed RSS 6GiB; series output 10MiB; stop on first failure
policy.interference: interactive host, not CPU-pinned or isolated; resource preflight before each point
